name: theme-factory
headline: Boost Your Vue.js Apps with Nuxt Skills
short_description: Nuxt Skills helps developers to efficiently build and optimize Vue.js applications with streamlined workflows. Unlock faster deployment and enhanced performance while leveraging best practices in your projects.
author: sh

sections.overview:
Nuxt Skills is a design-focused AI agent skill that helps developers build and optimize Vue.js applications with streamlined workflows. It enables faster deployment cycles and improved application performance by incorporating best practices into development processes. This skill is owned by sh and targets developers looking to enhance their Vue.js project efficiency.
Rapid development of Vue.js applications
SEO optimization for web projects
Improved site performance and load times
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`npx skills add sh/onmax`
`git clone https://github.com/sh/onmax`
sections.usage:
```
Help me optimize my Nuxt.js application for [COMPANY]. I need to improve the performance of [INDUSTRY] application by implementing best practices. Provide a step-by-step guide with code examples.
```
Copy

```
# Nuxt.js Optimization Guide for [COMPANY]
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Codex
```
